span: the principles of “creamy layer” are not applicable for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes
why: Quoted observation on the creamy layer; about who is excluded from reservation, not promotion.

span: Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes are not a caste within the ordinary meaning of caste
why: Reports observations of an earlier Chief Justice on the nature of the Scheduled Castes list; not on promotion.

span: the incumbent has to furnish in the first instance the place of origin/domicile of that particular region
why: Eligibility for SC/ST certificates for region-based castes; not promotion.

span: it is permissible to make sub-classification within socially and educationally backward classes
why: Headnote on sub-classification of Scheduled Castes within Art. 16(4); the proposition concerns reservation in promotion.

span: relaxation of qualifying marks in any examination or lowering the standards of evaluation
why: Quotes the proviso to Article 335 (which mentions promotion) while framing whether Art. 335 limits reservations; no position stated yet.

span: Thus, reservations in promotions were extended to members of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes alone.
why: Court explains that Art. 16(4A), inserted to negate Indra Sawhney, lets the State provide reservation in promotion for SC and ST.
